authoringStatement: V2 expectations were authored by hand from docs/V2_PROGRESSION_OPTIMIZER_CONTRACT.md before any production progression optimizer existed. Every search outcome, counter value, front, and refusal in these fixtures was derived on paper from the frozen semantics; the validator independently recomputes each with its own reference implementations and rejects divergence. No value was produced by, or copied from, production optimizer output.

classificationPolicy.primary-standard: A current normative Web platform standard.
classificationPolicy.reviewed-contract: A normative repository architecture or package decision.
classificationPolicy.legacy-observation: A reproduced legacy failure the replacement must not preserve.
classificationPolicy.mechanical-derivation: A direct result of a declared formula, integer algorithm, or cap.
classificationPolicy.human-review: A judgment that automation cannot honestly certify.
